## Activity

East City Eye Clinic completed 212 retinal image captures during April 2023. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Activity was delivered in line with the expected service arrangements for the month, with no reported disruption to scheduled sessions.

The available activity record indicates that the clinic maintained regular imaging provision throughout the reporting period. Captures were submitted for grading following the clinic’s usual process.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable image sets. This represented an ungradable rate of 1.9 per cent of all captures. The rate provides an overall measure of image quality for the reporting period and identifies the examinations that could not be assessed reliably from the submitted images.

## Grading

A total of 42 results were graded as referable. These results require the appropriate follow-up through the established clinical pathway.

The median grading wait was 3 days. This indicates the typical interval between image submission and completion of grading, with half of graded results completed within that interval and half taking longer. Overall, the reported activity, image quality and grading measures provide a summary of East City Eye Clinic’s service performance for April 2023.
